mapper.select: SELECT /* Region.retrieveInitUserData */ #{ssoId} AS sso_id ,src.application_user_id ,src.request_region_code ,rgn.region_name AS request_region_name ,src.request_region_code_use_flag ,src.default_org_id ,dou.default_org_code ,dou.default_org_name ,src.default_org_id_use_flag ,src.server_time_difference_seqs FROM (SELECT a.application_user_id ,a.request_region_code ,NVL(a.request_region_code_use_flag, 'N') AS request_region_code_use_flag ,a.default_org_id ,NVL(a.default_org_id_use_flag, 'N') AS default_org_id_use_flag ,a.server_time_difference_seqs FROM lgcom_user_m a WHERE a.request_region_code IS NOT NULL AND a.application_user_id = (SELECT slv2.user_id FROM lgcom_sso_login_v slv2 WHERE SUBSTR(slv2.email_id, 1, INSTR(slv2.email_id, '@') - 1) = #{ssoId} AND ROWNUM = 1) UNION ALL SELECT a.application_user_id ,(SELECT lcc.code_data1_value FROM lgcom_user_m lum ,lgcom_common_code_c lcc WHERE lum.user_name = a.user_name AND lcc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_SUBSIDIARY_TYPE_CODE' AND lum.subsidiary_id = lcc.common_code) request_region_code ,NVL(a.request_region_code_use_flag, 'N') AS request_region_code_use_flag ,a.default_org_id ,NVL(a.default_org_id_use_flag, 'N') AS default_org_id_use_flag ,a.server_time_difference_seqs FROM lgcom_user_m a WHERE a.request_region_code IS NULL AND a.application_user_id = (SELECT slv2.user_id FROM lgcom_sso_login_v slv2 WHERE SUBSTR(slv2.email_id, 1, INSTR(slv2.email_id, '@') - 1) = #{ssoId} AND ROWNUM = 1)) src ,(SELECT lcc.common_code AS region_code ,lcc.common_code_desc AS region_name FROM lgcom_common_code_c lcc WHERE lcc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_TIMEZONE_DEFAULT_COMPANY' AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y') rgn ,(SELECT lc1.common_code AS default_org_id ,lc1.code_data1_value AS default_org_code ,lc1.common_code_desc AS default_org_name FROM lgcom_common_code_c lc1 WHERE lc1.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_OU_INFO' AND lc1.use_flag = 'Y') dou WHERE src.request_region_code = rgn.region_code(+) AND src.default_org_id = dou.default_org_id(+)

SELECT /* Region.retrieveUserRegionList */ application_user_id , request_region_code , request_region_name , request_region_code_use_flag , default_org_id , default_org_code , default_org_name , user_org_id , user_org_code , user_org_name , user_org_use_flag , server_time_difference_seqs , ou_use_flag FROM TABLE(LGCOM_REGION_PKG.GET_REGIN_INFO(#{ssoId}))

SELECT /* Region.retrieveUserOrganizationUnitList */ a.application_user_id , a.company_id AS organization_id , b.short_code AS organization_code , b.name AS organization_name FROM ( SELECT lur.application_user_id , lrb.company_id FROM LGCOM_ROLE_BIZ_ORG_N lrb , LGCOM_USER_ROLE_N lur , LGCOM_ROLE_M lr WHERE lrb.role_code = lur.role_code AND lur.role_code = lr.role_code AND (lur.apply_start_date IS NULL OR lur.apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (lur.apply_end_date IS NULL OR lur.apply_end_date >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 23:59:59','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AND (lr.apply_start_date IS NULL OR lr.apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (lr.apply_end_date IS NULL OR lr.apply_end_date >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 23:59:59','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AND lrb.organization_type_code = 'C' AND lur.application_user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM LGCOM_SSO_LOGIN_V WHERE SUBSTR(email_id,1,INSTR(email_id,'@')-1) = #{ssoId} ) GROUP BY lur.application_user_id,lrb.company_id ) a , lgcom_company_v b WHERE a.company_id = b.organization_id ORDER BY a.company_id, b.name
